components.note: 牛 (ox) — leading an ox by a rope; as a part, 牛 marks cattle and animals, as in 物 thing, 特 special, 牧 herd.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — birds, here the eagle; also in 难, 谁, 集.
周 (zhōu) is a loose clue; 调 diào and 凋 diāo share it and sound the same as 雕.
彳 (step, 双人旁) — walking along a path, as in 行 go, 往 toward; 循 is to follow a route.
盾 (dùn) is only a loose sound clue for xún.
马 (horse) — horses and riding, as in 骑 ride, 驾 drive, 驴 donkey.
区 (qū) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 躯 qū.
木 (wood) — trees; 柠 is the lemon tree, as in 树 tree, 林 forest.
宁 (níng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 拧 níng and 狞 níng.
木 (wood) — trees; 檬 appears in 柠檬 lemon, as in 树 tree, 林 forest.
蒙 (méng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 朦 méng.
山 (mountain) — a gorge lies between mountains; also in 峰 peak, 岛 island.
夹 (jiā) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 狭 xiá and 侠 xiá.
谷 — water (八) flowing out of a valley mouth (口). It also sounds out 浴 yù, 欲 yù and 俗 sú.
北 — two people (匕) back to back; the meaning "north" is a later loan, and "back" survives in the reading bèi (败北 defeat).
艹 (grass) — plants; 葡 is the grape plant, as in 草 grass, 花 flower.
匍 (pú) gives the exact sound.
艹 (grass) — plants; 萄 is part of 葡萄 grape, as in 草 grass, 花 flower.
匋 (táo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 陶 táo and 淘 táo.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — organs and body parts, as in 肺 lung, 胃 stomach, 脑 brain.
干 (gān) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 竿 gān and 杆 gǎn.
口 (mouth) — holding something in the mouth; also in 吃 eat, 吞 swallow.
今 (jīn) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 贪 tān and 琴 qín.
⺮ (bamboo, 竹字头) — counting rods were bamboo; also in 笑 smile, 筷 chopsticks.
寿 (shòu) is only a loose sound clue for chóu.
廴 (long stride) — stretching a journey out; also in 建 build. 延 also sounds out 诞 dàn.
寸 (hand, also "inch") — a grasping hand seizing something; also in 对, 守, 寺.
扌 (hand) — digging by hand; also in 打 hit, 拉 pull.
穴 (cave, hole) — digging makes a hole; as in 空 empty, 窗 window.
扌 (hand) — digging by hand; also in 挖 dig, 拉 pull.
屈 (qū) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 崛 jué and 窟 kū.
戈 (spear) — weapons and war, as in 战 war, 武 martial.
翏 (liù) is only a loose sound clue for lù.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — strolling, as in 道 road, 过 pass, 进 enter.
肖 (xiào) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 消 xiāo and 销 xiāo.
辶 (walk) — a long journey; also in 远 far, 道 road.
䍃 (yáo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 摇 yáo and 谣 yáo.
土 (earth) — a lump of earth; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
夬 (guài) is a loose clue; 快 kuài shares it and sounds exactly like 块.
艹 (grass) — plants; 草 is grass itself, as in 花 flower, 菜 vegetable.
早 (zǎo) shares the rhyme -ǎo with cǎo, a loose sound clue.
艹 (grass) — plants; 莓 is a berry plant, as in 草 grass, 花 flower.
每 (měi) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 梅 méi and 悔 huǐ.
忄 (heart) — alertness of the heart; also in 怕 afraid, 快 happy.
易 (yì) is a loose clue; 踢 tī shares it and sounds like 惕 tì.
日 (sun) — summer heat; also in 明 bright, 晴 sunny.
者 (zhě) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 署 shǔ and 薯 shǔ, which sound the same as 暑.
亻 (person) — urging someone; also in 他 he, 们 plural.
崔 (cuī) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 摧 cuī.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 腿 leg, 脸 face.
却 (què) is only a loose sound clue for jiǎo.
足 (foot, ⻊) — foot words, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump.
止 (zhǐ) gives the exact sound; it is also an old picture of a foot, and also sounds out 址 zhǐ.
耳 (ear) — ear radical, as in 聪 clever, 聋 deaf; 耽 first meant drooping ears.
冘 (yín) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 枕 zhěn and 沉 chén.
扌 (hand) — drafting by hand; also in 打 hit, 抄 copy.
以 (yǐ) is only a stand-in for the sound; the traditional 擬 had 疑 yí.
朿 (cì, a thorn) — two thorns side by side make a thorny shrub; 朿 also appears in 刺 cì.
扌 (hand) — blocking with the hand; also in 挡 block, 推 push.
兰 (lán) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 栏 lán and 烂 làn.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metal and money, as in 钱 money, 银 silver.
少 (shǎo) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 抄 chāo, which sounds the same as 钞.
鸟 — the picture of a bird; simplified from 鳥. The bird radical, as in 鸡 chicken, 鸭 duck, 鸽 pigeon.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — pulling out a thread, hence unraveling; the right part also appears in 译 yì, 释 shì and 泽 zé.
禾 (grain) — crops; 穆 first named a ripe grain. Also in 种 plant, 秋 autumn.
玉 (jade) — playing with a piece of jade; also in 国 country, 宝 treasure.
廾 (two hands) — hands holding something; 弄 is to handle or play with.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words, as in 说 say, 话 speech; 诗 is spoken verse.
寺 (sì) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 时 shí, 持 chí and 特 tè.
九 — originally a bent arm (elbow), later borrowed to write nine. 九 also sounds out 究 jiū and 鸠 jiū.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — money; also in 钱 money, 银 silver.
旁 (páng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 磅 bàng and 傍 bàng.
口 (mouth) — spoken orders; also in 叫 shout, 说 speak.
分 (fēn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 纷 fēn, 芬 fēn and 粉 fěn.
口 (mouth) — spoken instructions; also in 叫 shout, 问 ask.
付 (fù) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 附 fù.
丫 — a picture of a fork or branching twig, hence anything forked.
孚 (a hand over a child) — the usual reading is a mother nursing her child, hence breast and milk.
亻 (person) — a person leaning to one side; also in 他 he, 们 plural.
扁 (biǎn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 篇 piān and 遍 biàn.
